meta.title: fokia — seafood bar | Fish, sushi and cocktails
meta.description: fokia is a seafood bar pairing fresh Greek fish with Japanese technique. Sushi, raw plates, hot dishes and cocktails built on Greek spirits.
meta.menuDescription: The full fokia menu: salads, raw and hot starters, sushi, maki, noodles, main courses, wines and cocktails. Served in Greek.
meta.teamDescription: The people behind the counter and the bar at fokia: the chef, the kitchen and the service.
meta.galleryDescription: Photographs from fokia: the room, the plates, the cocktails and the team.
hero.intro: A refined expression of the sea • crafted moments, timeless taste.
goal.body: We started fokia on a simple idea: good fish does not need much. It needs to be fresh, cut properly, and reach the table without anything unnecessary in the way. We work Greek ingredients with techniques learned from the Japanese kitchen — raw, seared, cured — and pour cocktails built around Greek spirits alongside them.
goal.body2: The menu shifts with what the sea brings in. Everything we serve raw follows the prescribed 24-hour freezing protocol, because safety is not negotiable.

contact.events: Call us to plan your own event — a corporate lunch, a party, an opening, an anniversary, a birthday, a name day — with a custom menu built around the quality and the creativity of Fokia Seafood Bar, at your own venue.
contact.sourcing: Through our suppliers we have access to the finest ingredients on the market. If there is something special you would like to taste and share with your table, get in touch — we will find it and we will cook it for you.
